title: Unveiling the degradation of lamotrigine in sulfate radical-mediated oxidation: kinetics, influencing factors and transformation mechanisms
content:

Lamotrigine (LMG), a widely used anticonvulsant drug, has been frequently detected in aquatic environments, which can be effectively decomposed by sulfate radical oxidation processes.
